item.title: Motorcyclist critically injured in multi-vehicle crash
item.description: ST. LOUIS COUNTY, Mo. - A multi-vehicle crash involving a motorcyclist has left one person seriously injured Wednesday afternoon. According to police, the crash happened around 5:35 p.m. on I-64 near Brentwood Blvd., which is not far from the St. Louis Galleria Mall. item.title: Fire crews respond to hazmat situation in south STL
item.description: Crews from the St. Louis Fire Department say they are responding to hazmat spill in South St. Louis Wednesday evening.

item.title: Hole at busy south St. Louis intersection raises concerns
item.description: A large hole at a busy intersection in south St. Louis - marked only by a traffic cone, two small utility flags and the word "HOLE" spray-painted on the pavement, is raising concerns from some local community members.

item.title: North St. Louis tornado repair funds could run out by May without federal dollars
item.description: Nine months after a massive tornado tore through parts of St. Louis, thousands of are still awaiting repairs. Now, city officials warn that funding for those repairs could run out by April or May, even as they say delays in federal disaster dollars are not unusual.

item.title: St. Charles woman nearly scammed while searching for her missing dog
item.description: Jessica Etzel’s 6-year-old Siberian Husky has been missing since Feb. 11.

item.title: St. Louis Symphony Orchestra announces 2026-2027 lineup
item.description: The St. Louis Symphony Orchestra announced its 2026–2027 schedule Wednesday, marking its 147th year with a lineup of popular symphonic works, premieres, and live movie scores.

item.title: Former injured STL officer undergoes partial leg amputation, hopes to inspire first responders
item.description: A line-of-duty injury nearly took his life. Four years later, a former St. Louis Metropolitan Police officer is faced with a new challenge.

item.title: 22-year-old convicted killer found dead in Missouri prison
item.description: Two years after being sentenced for a murder he committed as a teen, a St. James, Missouri, man was found dead at Potosi Correctional Center in Mineral Point.

item.title: Defense Sec. Hegseth visits Boeing, praises workforce
item.description: The stop was part of a nationwide “Arsenal of Freedom” tour, which the department describes as a “call to action to revitalize America's manufacturing might and re-energize the nation's workforce.”

item.title: Downtown parking crisis upsets residents
item.description: Locals claim enforcement is nearly nonexistent and that these issues have persisted for at least two years.
